params.body:
The repair layer on the project page was headed "Repair on stocklist:platform", the resource name the gateway and the grant use. That is not a name the owner knows the system by. The heading is now the project's own title, "Repair on Stocklistdealer.eu platform", with the resource after it in small muted text for whoever needs it.

`RepairLayerTest` asserts both. Its 5 tests pass, and Pint passes.
params.title: The repair layer is headed by the project's own name
